register.labelZh: FIT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: fit in 可以描述某人融入群體,也可以表示建築物、顏色或風格與周圍環境協調。；fit in 和 fit into 可幫助你說明家具、袋、箱子或人是否有足夠空間。；fit somebody in 可以表示醫生、老師或工作人員抽時間安排某人;fit something in 則可表示騰出時間或空間加入額外物件或活動。；fit somebody up for a crime 表示栽贓某人;fit somebody or something up withequipment 則表示為某人或某物配備用品。
register.summaryEn: Fit in can describe a person becoming part of a group. It can also show that a building, colour or style looks right with its surroundings. Fit in and fit into help you explain whether furniture, bags, boxes or people have enough room. Fit somebody in can show that a doctor, teacher or worker makes time for someone. Fit something in can show that space or time is found for an extra item or activity. Fit somebody up for a crime means to frame the person. Fit somebody or something up with equipment means to provide useful items.
